vignettes_*.jsonl.note: DEPRECATED as an evaluation set as of 1.4.0. 560 rows carry only 94 distinct texts (2 names x 3 intensity levels, text byte-identical across levels), 9 scenarios leak across the train/test boundary, and attribution has zero variance. Retained for reproducing pre-1.4.0 results only. See QC_FINDINGS.md; use vignettes_diagnostic.jsonl.

envent_*.jsonl.note: 1200 event descriptions, each rated by 5 independent readers reconstructing the experiencer's appraisal on 21 variables; consensus mapped onto our 17-dim schema (fairness unmapped - no SEC analog). anticipated_emotion is author-grounded. Human gold. Troiano, Oberlander & Klinger (2023), Computational Linguistics 49(1), doi:10.1162/coli_a_00461.

annotation/pilot_model_annotations.json.note: 20-vignette pilot rated by a model, NOT human gold and never to be merged into one. Ran to validate the Label Studio label config and scale behaviour before the Prolific study. The rows were deleted from the Label Studio project on 2026-09-19; this archived file is all that remains of them.

vignettes_diagnostic.jsonl.note: The 94 distinct scenarios behind vignettes_*, one row per text, priors averaged across the intensity levels that shared that text (prior_spread records the disagreement). Family-balanced diagnostic probe, NOT the flagship eval set and NOT human gold - eval runs against it stay status=smoke. Do not carve a holdout from it: nothing is trained, so a split only discards power.

note: per-file provenance. mindcore vignettes remain generator_priors (smoke) until the human annotation study lands; the envent_* split is human-rated (measured).
